findings.highlight: I came back here for Sakura.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は桜のために戻ってきた」
findings.governingReading: The Japanese quote closes before Rin’s reaction.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s complete reply has no closing quotation mark.

findings.evidenceJa: 心臓の横に作られた、誓約という名の戒め
findings.governingReading: 心臓の横に作られた identifies the separate magical formation beside the heart, explicitly distinguishing it from the heart’s motion.
findings.explanation: The oath-restraint made beside the heart becomes one binding the heart itself.

findings.governingReading: 別に answers Shirou’s question whether his answer was wrong in14p2; the recalled reply denies that premise.
findings.explanation: Rin’s recalled no/not particularly answer becomes an additive Also.
